reason: SART is a specific iterative solver for the data fidelity term in tomographic inverse problems, making it a child of the general optimization framework rather than a sibling of SIRT (which solves a different specific problem) or a component like forward projection.

SART is an iterative reconstruction method that modifies the algebraic update scheme of SIRT (which normalizes by sensitivity) by using simultaneous updates for all rays in a view, making it a specific variant under the SIRT family of algebraic reconstruction techniques.
